concepts.quote: Only start, because done is inside the if and 3 is not > 5.
concepts.why: Treats the unbraced println("done") as part of the if body, contradicting the rule that a braceless if governs only the single next statement; the actual output for 3 is start, done (and for five a NumberFormatException), and the 'five' case is ignored.
The answer says nothing about the class declaration.
